title: BitBoard | BitBoard Docs
text:
Build hosted dashboards and reports with your agent.

BitBoard
BitBoard is a persistent analytics workspace for dashboards built by people and agents. Your data, queries, transforms, charts, and controls stay together at one shareable URL, so teammates can inspect the work and run it again.
Build dashboards with your agent
Section titled “Build dashboards with your agent”
Connect Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, or another MCP-compatible agent. The agent can create dashboards, load data, author blocks, arrange layouts, and share the result while you watch the dashboard update.
Connect your agent or build your first dashboard.
Ask about your data
Section titled “Ask about your data”
Ask is BitBoard’s built-in agent for grounded questions across your connected data and apps. It is separate from the third-party agents you connect through MCP to build dashboards.
Ask is in beta. Its capabilities and workflows may change while we learn how teams use grounded answers.
Learn how Ask works or connect your data and apps.
Open BitBoard
Section titled “Open BitBoard”
Go to app.bitboard.work.
